give.prompt: Mere ghar ka bijli bill zyada aa raha hai. Detective bano: yeh mere last 3 months ke bill amounts hain — [April ___, May ___, June ___]. Appliances: AC (inverter/non-inverter?) __ hrs/day, fridge, TV, geyser, washing machine. Seasonal jump nikaalo, appliance-wise hisaab do, sabse bada culprit batao aur uska per-hour cost estimate karo.
